'''Ravi Dubey''' (born 23 December 1983) is an Indian actor, model, television presenter and producer.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/adaa-khan-ravi-dubey-to-perform-together-this-holi/articleshow/57594540.cms |title=Adaa Khan, Ravi Dubey to perform together this Holi |date=11 March 2017 |work=The Times of India |access-date=20 December 2019 |archive-date=25 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201025033625/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/adaa-khan-ravi-dubey-to-perform-together-this-holi/articleshow/57594540.cms |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Keshri |first=Shweta |date=6 May 2021 |title=Udaariyaan producers Sargun Mehta, Ravi Dubey get their entire cast and crew vaccinated|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/television/celebrity/story/udaariyaan-producers-sargun-mehta-ravi-dubey-get-their-entire-cast-and-crew-vaccinated-1799534-2021-05-06|access-date=29 August 2021|magazine=India Today}}</ref> He began his acting career with supporting or character roles in shows such as ''[[Stree Teri Kahani]]'' (2006–09), ''[[Doli Saja Ke]]'' (2007–09), and ''[[Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar]]'' (2011–13). He later went on to star in the family dramas ''[[Saas Bina Sasural]]'' (2010–12) and ''[[Jamai Raja (2014 TV series)|Jamai Raja]]'' (2014–17). The latter established him as one of the leading Indian TV actors. He also participated in reality shows ''[[Nach Baliye 5]]'' (2012) and ''[[Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 8]]'' (2017).<ref>{{cite news |title=Ravi Dubey was Offered This Whopping Amount for Jamai 2.0 Season 2? |url=https://www.news18.com/news/movies/ravi-dubey-was-offered-this-whopping-amount-for-jamai-2-0-season-2-3321593.html |accessdate=2 March 2021 |work=News18 |date=21 January 2021 |archive-date=22 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210122000732/https://www.news18.com/news/movies/ravi-dubey-was-offered-this-whopping-amount-for-jamai-2-0-season-2-3321593.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=MX Player's latest thriller Matsya Kaand is a big hit among the audience as it crosses 100 million views |url=https://www.businessinsider.in/entertainment/news/mx-players-latest-thriller-matsya-kaand-is-a-big-hit-among-the-audience-as-it-crosses-100-million-views/articleshow/88454486.cms |access-date=5 January 2022 |work=Business Insider |date=23 December 2021 |archive-date=4 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220104194617/https://www.businessinsider.in/entertainment/news/mx-players-latest-thriller-matsya-kaand-is-a-big-hit-among-the-audience-as-it-crosses-100-million-views/articleshow/88454486.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> 

In 2016, Dubey founded the production house Dreamiyata Entertainment Pvt Ltd, producing television series such as ''[[Udaariyaan]]'' (2021–24) and [[Punjabi cinema|Punjabi]] films like ''[[Saunkan Saunkne|Saunkan Saunkane]]'' (2022) and ''[[Saunkan Saunkanay 2]]'' (2025)''.''

== Early life ==

Dubey was born in [[Gorakhpur]], [[Uttar Pradesh]] and was brought up in [[Delhi]], India.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Sargun-will-always-be-special-to-me-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/20876992.cms|title=Sargun will always be special to me: Ravi Dubey|work=The Times of India|date=3 July 2013|access-date=17 May 2014|archive-date=13 March 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150313172356/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Sargun-will-always-be-special-to-me-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/20876992.cms|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/events/delhi/Sargun-Mehta-and-Ravi-Dubey-tie-the-knot-in-Delhi/articleshow/27086307.cms|title=Sargun Mehta and Ravi Dubey tie the knot in Delhi|work=The Times of India|date=9 December 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/events/delhi/Sargun-Mehta-and-Ravi-Dubey-tie-the-knot-in-Delhi/articleshow/27086307.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> His father, Gyan Prakash Dubey, is a Civil Engineer, who worked with management in various real estate organisations in the Delhi/NCR Region.{{citation needed|date=August 2024}}

Dubey moved to [[Mumbai]] from [[Delhi]] to study [[Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering|electronic and telecommunications engineering]] at the [[Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology, Mumbai|Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology]].<ref name="TOI_Jul_2014"/><ref>{{cite news |title=Meet the highly educated TV stars |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/ram-kapoor-to-mouni-roy-meet-the-highly-educated-tv-stars/photostory/65085528.cms?picid=65369747 |work=The Times of India |date=21 April 2019 |access-date=28 August 2024}}</ref> Later, he started working as a model.<ref name="TOI_Jul_2014">{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/Ravi-Dubey-Im-waiting-for-the-right-project-to-make-my-Bollywood-debut/articleshow/38935932.cms|title=Ravi Dubey: I'm waiting for the right project to make my Bollywood debut|work=The Times of India|date=24 July 2014|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=15 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150915173324/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/Ravi-Dubey-Im-waiting-for-the-right-project-to-make-my-Bollywood-debut/articleshow/38935932.cms|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-buddhism-saved-ravi-dubey-from-suicide-1558551|title=Buddhism saved Ravi Dubey from suicide!|work=[[Daily News and Analysis]]|date=24 June 2011|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=19 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140519191200/http://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-buddhism-saved-ravi-dubey-from-suicide-1558551|url-status=live}}</ref>

== Career ==

===Television debut (2006–2009)===
Dubey started his career as a model,<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Men-who-rocked-TV-in-2010/articleshow/7178547.cms|title=Men who rocked TV in 2010|work=The Times of India|date=1 January 2011|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Men-who-rocked-TV-in-2010/articleshow/7178547.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> then he started his acting career in 2006 with the parallel lead role of Ravi Agarwal in the [[DD National]] television show ''[[Stree Teri Kahani|Stree... Teri Kahaani]]'', which was produced by actors [[Dilip Kumar]] and [[Saira Banu]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.tribuneindia.com/2013/20130608/ttlife1.htm|title=Firm as anchor|publisher=[[The Tribune (Chandigarh)]]|date=8 June 2013|access-date=15 February 2015|archive-date=15 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150215060238/http://www.tribuneindia.com/2013/20130608/ttlife1.htm|url-status=live}}</ref> Later he portrayed the small role of "Veer" in [[Sahara One]]'s soap opera ''[[Doli Saja Ke]]''.<ref name="subject-of-jamai">{{cite news|url=http://ibnlive.in.com/news/i-relate-to-the-subject-of-jamai-raja-well-ravi-dubey/489151-44-124.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140803064413/http://ibnlive.in.com/news/i-relate-to-the-subject-of-jamai-raja-well-ravi-dubey/489151-44-124.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=3 August 2014|title=I relate to the subject of 'Jamai Raja' well: Ravi Dubey|publisher=[[IBNLive]]|date=30 July 2014|access-date=13 February 2015}}</ref> Thereafter, he appeared as the male lead in ''[[Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar]]'', where he played the role of Ravi.<ref name="subject-of-jamai"/>

Dubey has done up to 40 television commercial ads, including [[Reliance Anil Dhirubhai Ambani Group|Reliance]], [[TVS Motor Company|TVS Victor]], Mrs. Marino, Gee Pee Mobile, [[Nestle]], [[ICICI Bank|ICICI]], Action Milano Shoes, Fairever, [[Hyundai Motor India Limited|Santro]] and Water Kingdom.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://daily.bhaskar.com/news/ravi-uncomfortable-with-tej-1515241.html|title=Ravi uncomfortable with Tej|publisher=[[Daily Bhaskar]]|date=2 November 2010|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=11 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150211111717/http://daily.bhaskar.com/news/ravi-uncomfortable-with-tej-1515241.html|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="breaking-stereotypes">{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-is-breaking-stereotypes/articleshow/7247252.cms|title=Ravi Dubey is breaking stereotypes|work=The Times of India|date=10 January 2011|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-is-breaking-stereotypes/articleshow/7247252.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

In December 2008, Dubey replaced [[Vinay Rohrra]] for portraying the male lead in [[Zee TV|Zee television]]'s show ''[[Ranbir Rano]]''.<ref name="breaking-stereotypes"/><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-ranbir-gets-replaced-1216694|title=Ranbir gets replaced!|publisher=[[DNA India]]|date=25 December 2008|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=13 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150213181232/http://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-ranbir-gets-replaced-1216694|url-status=live}}</ref> After the show ended, Dubey was cast opposite [[Sargun Mehta]] in Zee television's soap opera ''[[12/24 Karol Bagh]]''.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/I-met-Sargun-in-Delhi-says-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/23357342.cms|title=I met Sargun in Delhi, says Ravi Dubey|work=The Times of India|date=2 October 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/I-met-Sargun-in-Delhi-says-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/23357342.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Breakthrough (2010–2013)===
In October 2010, Dubey featured opposite [[Aishwarya Sakhuja]] for [[Sony Entertainment Television (India)|Sony Entertainment Television]]'s romantic/drama show ''[[Saas Bina Sasural]]'', in which he portrayed the male lead role of Tej Prakash Chaturvedi.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://daily.bhaskar.com/article/no-saas-in-sonys-sasuraal-1459469.html|title=No Saas in Sony's Sasuraal|publisher=Daily Bhaskar|date=15 October 2010|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=13 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150213220451/http://daily.bhaskar.com/article/no-saas-in-sonys-sasuraal-1459469.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> While working in the show, Dubey started his film career in [[Bollywood]]; he signed for Aron Govil's 2011 Hindi film ''[[U R My Jaan]]''.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Chaubey |first=Pranita |date=4 July 2019 |title=Inside Ravi Dubey And Sargun Mehta's Dreamy Vacation In Maldives |url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/inside-ravi-dubey-and-sargun-mehtas-dreamy-vacation-in-maldives-2064331 |work=NDTV |access-date=14 November 2022 |archive-date=14 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221114062122/https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/inside-ravi-dubey-and-sargun-mehtas-dreamy-vacation-in-maldives-2064331 |url-status=live }}</ref>

In January 2012, Dubey participated in Sony Entertainment Television's reality-based comedy series of ''[[Comedy Circus]]'' titled, ''Kahani Comedy Circus Ki''. Dubey said, "I am super excited as I have always loved the show. So far I have never had the opportunity to try my hands at comedy, which I believe is the toughest of all".<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.mid-day.com/articles/comedy-toughest-of-all-ravi-dubey/148805|title=Comedy toughest of all: Ravi Dubey|date=4 January 2012|work=[[Mid-Day]]|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=13 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150213190646/http://www.mid-day.com/articles/comedy-toughest-of-all-ravi-dubey/148805|url-status=live}}</ref>

In December 2012, Dubey participated in the [[Nach Baliye 5|fifth season]] of [[Star Plus]] television's celebrity couple dance reality show ''[[Nach Baliye]]'', along with [[Sargun Mehta]]. And on 23 March 2013, in the finale episode, He became the first runner-up of the show.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.emirates247.com/entertainment/nach-baliye-5-jay-mahhi-winners-shilpa-kills-it-on-the-dance-floor-2013-03-24-1.499711|title=Nach Baliye 5: Jay, Mahhi winners; Shilpa kills it on the dance floor|author=Staff|publisher=Emirates 24-7|date=24 March 2013|access-date=13 February 2015|archive-date=13 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150213183907/http://www.emirates247.com/entertainment/nach-baliye-5-jay-mahhi-winners-shilpa-kills-it-on-the-dance-floor-2013-03-24-1.499711|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2013-05-24/tv/39501118_1_sargun-mehta-ravi-dubey-nach-baliye |archive-url=https://archive.today/20131104183540/http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2013-05-24/tv/39501118_1_sargun-mehta-ravi-dubey-nach-baliye |url-status=dead |archive-date=4 November 2013 |work=[[The Times of India]] |title=The Times of India: Latest News India, World & Business News, Cricket & Sports, Bollywood |access-date=17 May 2014}}</ref> Dubey also participated in another of [[Nach Baliye]]'s celebrity couple dance reality series titled, ''[[Nach Baliye Shriman v/s Shrimati]]'' in 2013.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/television/top-stories/story/nach-baliye-shriman-vs-shrimati-ends-in-a-tie-159568-2013-04-21|title=Nach Baliye Shriman v/s Shrimati in a tie|publisher=[[India Today]]|date=22 April 2013|access-date=17 May 2014|archive-date=26 June 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150626182715/http://indiatoday.intoday.in/story/nach-baliye-shriman-vs-shrimati-ends-in-a-tie/1/266996.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

In May 2013, Dubey started hosting television shows, He replaced [[Mohit Malhotra]] to host [[Star Plus]] television's dance reality show ''India's Dancing Superstar''.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Iconic-faces-of-TV-are-now-coming-back-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/20493298.cms|title=Iconic faces of TV are now coming back: Ravi Dubey|work=The Times of India|date=8 June 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Iconic-faces-of-TV-are-now-coming-back-Ravi-Dubey/articleshow/20493298.cms|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-replaces-Mohit-Malhotra/articleshow/20151618.cms|title=Ravi Dubey replaces Mohit Malhotra|work=The Times of India|date=21 May 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-replaces-Mohit-Malhotra/articleshow/20151618.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

In September 2013, he was approached for the lead role of Rajbir in Rashmi Sharma's show ''[[Desh Ki Beti Nandini]]'', but he was out of the show.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Keerti-Nagpure-is-Nandini-Ravi-Dubey-roped-in/articleshow/22224396.cms|title=Keerti Nagpure is Nandini; Ravi Dubey roped in?|work=The Times of India|date=2 September 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=4 February 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160204174529/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Keerti-Nagpure-is-Nandini-Ravi-Dubey-roped-in/articleshow/22224396.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> Dubey has also appeared along with [[Shweta Salve]] at [[Indian Television Academy Awards|Indian Television Academy]]'s ramp show ''Fashion Ka Jalwa''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://photogallery.indiatimes.com/fashion/indian-shows/itas-fashion-ka-jalwa/articleshow/16911358.cms |title=Ravi Dubey and Shweta Salve walk the ramp during ITA's 'Fashion Ka Jalwa' show held at Filmcity in Mumbai on October 21, 2012 |work=The Times of India |date=21 October 2012 |access-date=19 May 2014 |archive-date=19 May 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140519203943/http://photogallery.indiatimes.com/fashion/indian-shows/itas-fashion-ka-jalwa/articleshow/16911358.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Further success and production (2014–2025)===
In March 2014, Dubey got the male lead in Zee television's soap opera ''[[Jamai Raja (2014 TV series)|Jamai Raja]]'', in which he plays the role of Siddharth "Sid" Khurana opposite [[Nia Sharma]], the show produced by actor [[Akshay Kumar]] and co-produced by Ashvini Yardi, under their own production banner, ''[[Grazing Goat Pictures]]''.<ref name="indiatimes1">{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-in-Kunal-Verma-out-production-house-changes-hands/articleshow/31604221.cms|title=Ravi Dubey in, Kunal Verma out; production house changes hands|work=The Times of India|date=7 March 2014|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=14 July 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714131046/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/tv/news-interviews/Ravi-Dubey-in-Kunal-Verma-out-production-house-changes-hands/articleshow/31604221.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

In December 2014, Dubey hosted an award event of Zee televisions', [[Zee Rishtey Awards]], along with [[Shabbir Ahluwalia]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/television/top-stories/story/tv-stars-zee-rishtey-awards-mumbai-ravi-dubey-shabbir-ahluwalia-rajat-tokas-paridhi-sharma-achint-kaur-229262-2014-12-01|title=TV stars shine at Zee Rishtey Awards in Mumbai|publisher=India Today|date=1 December 2014|access-date=15 February 2015|archive-date=15 February 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150215103830/http://indiatoday.intoday.in/story/tv-stars-zee-rishtey-awards-mumbai-ravi-dubey-shabbir-ahluwalia-rajat-tokas-paridhi-sharma-achint-kaur/1/404542.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2017, Dubey participated in Colors stunt reality show ''[[Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 8]]'' in its eighth season where he ended up being the 2nd Runner-up while [[Shantanu Maheshwari]] was the winner and [[Hina Khan]] was the 1st Runner-up.<ref>{{cite news |title=Meet the final contestants of Khatron Ke Khiladi Season 8 |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/bollywood/meet-the-final-contestants-of-khatron-ke-khiladi-season-8/story-7ZjgOvwxl1v3ecBmx8GVXN.html |access-date=19 April 2022 |work=Hindustan Times |date=9 May 2017 |language=en |archive-date=8 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180808171528/https://www.hindustantimes.com/bollywood/meet-the-final-contestants-of-khatron-ke-khiladi-season-8/story-7ZjgOvwxl1v3ecBmx8GVXN.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="KKK86">{{cite news |title=Khatron Ke Khiladi 8: Ravi Dubey, Rithvik Dhanjani and Karan Wahi personify bromance. See photos |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/television/khatron-ke-khiladi-8-ravi-dubey-rithvik-dhanjani-and-karan-wahi-4727699/ |access-date=19 April 2022 |work=The Indian Express |date=29 June 2017 |language=en |archive-date=19 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220419154220/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/television/khatron-ke-khiladi-8-ravi-dubey-rithvik-dhanjani-and-karan-wahi-4727699/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Awaasthi |first1=Kavita |title=Khatron Ke Khiladi made me fearless: Ravi Dubey |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/tv/khatron-ke-khiladi-made-me-fearless-ravi-dubey/story-WVe4pvJw8d60HGZmsVANML.html |access-date=19 April 2022 |work=Hindustan Times |date=4 October 2017 |language=en |archive-date=30 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190730122526/https://www.hindustantimes.com/tv/khatron-ke-khiladi-made-me-fearless-ravi-dubey/story-WVe4pvJw8d60HGZmsVANML.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

In November 2017, Dubey was seen as one of the contestants in the Colors comedy show ''[[Entertainment Ki Raat]]'' along with [[Dipika Kakar]] and [[Asha Negi]]. He also participated in [[Star Plus]] reality show ''[[Lip Sing Battle]]'' along with wife [[Sargun Mehta]], [[Rithvik Dhanjani]] & [[Asha Negi]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kataruka |first1=Snehal |title=Ravi Dubey-Sargun Mehta, Rithvik Dhanjani-Asha Negi on Farah Khan's Lip Sing Battle |url=https://www.pinkvilla.com/tv/news-gossip/ravi-dubey-sargun-mehta-rithvik-dhanjani-asha-negi-farah-khans-lip-sing-battle-389389 |access-date=19 April 2022 |work=PINKVILLA |date=17 October 2017 |language=en |archive-date=11 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180911084549/https://www.pinkvilla.com/tv/news-gossip/ravi-dubey-sargun-mehta-rithvik-dhanjani-asha-negi-farah-khans-lip-sing-battle-389389 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In January 2018, Dubey hosted the Colors singing reality show ''[[Rising Star (Indian TV series)|Rising Star]]''.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/rising-star-2-ravi-dubey-surprises-everyone-with-his-rap-song-makes-wife-sargun-mehta-proud/articleshow/62981234.cms |title=Rising Star 2: Ravi Dubey surprises everyone with his rap song, makes wife Sargun Mehta proud |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=19 February 2018 |access-date=12 June 2022 |archive-date=3 September 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180903022553/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/rising-star-2-ravi-dubey-surprises-everyone-with-his-rap-song-makes-wife-sargun-mehta-proud/articleshow/62981234.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> In June 2018, he also hosted the Star Plus game show ''[[Sabse Smart Kaun]]''.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.freepressjournal.in/entertainment/ravi-dubey-to-host-game-show-sabse-smart-kaun/1275237|title=Ravi Dubey to host game show 'Sabse Smart Kaun?' {{!}} Free Press Journal|date=12 May 2018|work=Free Press Journal|access-date=22 July 2018|archive-date=22 July 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180722184711/http://www.freepressjournal.in/entertainment/ravi-dubey-to-host-game-show-sabse-smart-kaun/1275237|url-status=live}}</ref> In February 2019, Dubey replaced [[Aditya Narayan]] to host the seventh season of [[Sa Re Ga Ma Pa L'il Champs]] on [[Zee TV]]. He also hosted [[Zee Rishtey Awards]] in 2014, 2015, 2017, 2018 and 2019.

He made his debut into the digital space alongside Nia Sharma with the web series ''[[Jamai 2.0]]'', serving as the reboot of his Zee TV show ''Jamai Raja''. The series opened to good reviews.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://boxofficeindia.co.in/web-series-review-jamai-20|title=Web Series Review: Jamai 2.0|date=12 September 2019|website=Box Office India|access-date=6 March 2021|archive-date=24 October 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191024121305/https://boxofficeindia.co.in/web-series-review-jamai-20|url-status=live}}</ref> The second season released in February 2021. His next streaming venture was the web series ''[[Matsya Kaand]]'' on [[MX Player]], where he played the titular character Matsya.

In 2016, he founded his own production house Dreamiyata Entertainment Pvt Ltd, with his wife [[Sargun Mehta]] and co-produced Punjabi films, including ''[[Kala Shah Kala]]'' and ''[[Jhalle]]'' (both 2019), ''[[Saunkan Saunkne|Saunkan Saunkane]]'' (2022), and ''[[Saunkan Saunkanay 2]]'' (2025).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/punjabi/movies/news/watch-everyone-is-going-crazy-on-the-sets-of-jhalley/articleshow/70344009.cms |title=Watch: Everyone is going crazy on the sets of 'Jhalley' |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=23 July 2019 |access-date=4 January 2022 |archive-date=4 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220104200122/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/punjabi/movies/news/watch-everyone-is-going-crazy-on-the-sets-of-jhalley/articleshow/70344009.cms |url-status=live }}</ref> In March 2021, Dreamiyata Entertainment produced its first television series ''[[Udaariyaan]]'', which aired on Colors TV.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://news.abplive.com/videos/entertainment/television-ravi-dubey-his-wife-sargun-mehta-coming-up-with-new-show-udaarian-1443173|title=Ravi Dubey & his wife Sargun Mehta coming up with new show 'Udaarian|publisher=[[ABP Live]]|date=8 February 2021|access-date=4 January 2022|archive-date=4 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220104194619/https://news.abplive.com/videos/entertainment/television-ravi-dubey-his-wife-sargun-mehta-coming-up-with-new-show-udaarian-1443173|url-status=live}}</ref> Dubey followed this by producing mutilple television shows and streaming ventures across genres.

===''Ramayana'' (2026–present)===
In October 2024, Dubey was cast as [[Lakshmana]] in the upcoming ''Ramayana'' (2026) film, which will also mark his film acting debut.<ref>{{cite news |title=Actor Arun Govil as Dashrath, Ravi Dubey is Lakshman in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayan |url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/movies/news/actor-arun-govil-as-dashrath-ravi-dubey-is-lakshman-in-nitesh-tiwari-s-ramayan/ar-AA1t7Y9Q |work=MSN |date=29 October 2024 |access-date=30 October 2024}}</ref>

Dubey married actress [[Sargun Mehta]] on 7 December 2013.<ref name="marriage 1">{{cite news |last1=Nijher |first1=Jaspreet |title=Sargun and Ravi on pre-wedding holiday? |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/sargun-mehta-ravi-dubey-madhuri-dixit-ranbir-kapoor/articleshow/24094901.cms |access-date=26 June 2022 |work=The Times of India |date=13 October 2013 |language=en |archive-date=26 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220626183900/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/sargun-mehta-ravi-dubey-madhuri-dixit-ranbir-kapoor/articleshow/24094901.cms |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="marriage 2">{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/events/mumbai/TV-actors-Ravi-Dubey-and-Sargun-Mehta-tie-the-knot-in-Chandigarh/articlephotos/27132800.cms|title=TV actors Ravi Dubey and Sargun Mehta tie the knot in Chandigarh|work=The Times of India|date=10 December 2013|access-date=19 May 2014|archive-date=22 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160822220322/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/events/mumbai/TV-actors-Ravi-Dubey-and-Sargun-Mehta-tie-the-knot-in-Chandigarh/articlephotos/27132800.cms|url-status=live}}</ref>

Dubey is a follower of [[Nichiren Buddhism]].{{blockquote| He said, "I started following it (''Buddhism'') when I was going through a very rough patch in my life and I wanted some understanding of the chaos that was going on in one's life. I wanted to align myself and feel better about myself. So, when things went out of control, I started chanting at that time."<ref>{{Cite web|date=24 June 2011|title=Buddhism saved Ravi Dubey from suicide!|url=https://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-buddhism-saved-ravi-dubey-from-suicide-1558551|access-date=31 July 2021|website=DNA India|archive-date=31 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210731111502/https://www.dnaindia.com/entertainment/report-buddhism-saved-ravi-dubey-from-suicide-1558551|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=26 November 2013|title=All you want to know about Ravi Dubey and Sargun Mehta's big fat Indian wedding!|url=https://www.bollywoodlife.com/news-gossip/all-you-want-to-know-about-ravi-dubey-and-sargun-mehtas-big-fat-indian-wedding-293325/|access-date=31 July 2021|website=Bollywood Life|archive-date=31 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210731111503/https://www.bollywoodlife.com/news-gossip/all-you-want-to-know-about-ravi-dubey-and-sargun-mehtas-big-fat-indian-wedding-293325/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Keep gratitude in attitude: Ravi Dubey |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/keep-gratitude-in-attitude-ravi-dubey/articleshow/9235184.cms |access-date=31 July 2021 |work=The Times of India |date=16 July 2011 |archive-date=31 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210731111502/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/keep-gratitude-in-attitude-ravi-dubey/articleshow/9235184.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>}}

extract:
Ravi Dubey (born 23 December 1983) is an Indian actor, model, television presenter and producer. He began his acting career with supporting or character roles in shows such as Stree Teri Kahani (2006–09), Doli Saja Ke (2007–09), and Yahan Ke Hum Sikandar (2011–13). He later went on to star in the family dramas Saas Bina Sasural (2010–12) and Jamai Raja (2014–17). The latter established him as one of the leading Indian TV actors. He also participated in reality shows Nach Baliye 5 (2012) and Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 8 (2017). 
In 2016, Dubey founded the production house Dreamiyata Entertainment Pvt Ltd, producing television series such as Udaariyaan (2021–24) and Punjabi films like Saunkan Saunkane (2022) and Saunkan Saunkanay 2 (2025).
